title: New Next-Gen Dish Adds Muscle to NASA’s Deep Space Network
summary: NASA’s Deep Space Network facility in California is marking the addition of a brand new 34-meter-wide (114-foot-wide) radio frequency antenna to the agency’s deep space communications and navigation system.
